name: Scandinavian Defense
description: A direct black opening against 1.e4 that immediately challenges White's center pawn.

moves.explanation: White begins by claiming central space.
Black strikes the center right away and asks White to make a decision.

ideas: If White captures, recapture with the queen and develop carefully.
Do not chase pawns while your pieces are undeveloped.
commonMistakes: Moving the queen too many times after Qxd5.
Ignoring development after the center opens.
Letting White gain tempi with Nc3.
